exposure: Implementation of the revised neonatal resuscitation program (NRP 2015)
implementation of the revised neonatal resuscitation program guideline (Epoch-I vs. Epoch-II)
cohort: 168 periviable infants born at 22-25 weeks gestational age
finding: The implementation of the revised neonatal resuscitation program in 2015, which lowered the threshold of viability from 23 to 22 weeks gestational age, was associated with a significant increase in the survival rate of periviable infants.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was found to be a significant risk factor associated with the survival of periviable infants.
